title: Bias and the Brain Shortcut Lab

zones.label: Notice the Snap Judgment
zones.summary: Recognize the quick assumption before treating it as fact.
facts: Automatic thoughts can reflect repeated messages and past experience.
Having a thought is not the same as choosing an action.

zones.label: Pause
zones.summary: Slow the move from assumption to decision.
facts: A pause is especially useful when power or consequences are involved.

zones.label: Check Evidence
zones.summary: Ask what you actually know and what you inferred.

zones.label: Seek Perspective
zones.summary: Listen to people affected and consider viewpoints beyond your own.
facts: Do not demand that one person represent a whole group.
Credible history and data add context.

zones.label: Choose Fair Action
zones.summary: Make a choice that protects dignity, access, and consistent standards.
facts: Fair systems reduce reliance on individual perfection.
